units.source_text: 走过这所房子的时候，苗子的泪痕已经干了。

en.t: By the time they passed this house, the traces of Naeko's tears had already dried.

units.source_text: 究竟对千重子说这就是我们的家好呢，还是不说好？

en.t: Would it be better to tell Chieko that this was their home, or better not to say anything?

units.source_text: 千重子是在母亲的娘家出生的，大概没在这所房子住过。

en.t: Chieko had been born at her mother's family home, so she probably had never lived in this house.

units.source_text: 苗子还是婴儿的时候，母亲先于父亲与世长辞，所以连她也记不清自己是否在这所房子住过了。

en.t: When Naeko was still an infant, their mother passed away before their father, so even Naeko herself could not remember clearly whether she had ever lived in this house.
